categories.description: Lint rules, fixes, reports and file selection.
categories.name: Options

options.summary: Apply available lint fixes to files
options.detail: Safe fixes are enabled by default. Remaining violations are still reported and normally give exit status 1.

options.summary: Allow fixes that may change behavior
options.detail: Use with --fix to apply them or --diff to inspect them. Enabling unsafe fixes alone does not turn on fixing.

options.summary: Show lint fixes without writing files
options.detail: Implies --fix-only. Exit 1 if a fix would change a file. An unfixable violation alone produces no diff and exits 0.

options.summary: Set the base lint rules
options.detail: Use comma-separated codes or prefixes such as E,F401. ALL selects all rules. Use --extend-select to add to the current selection. Ruff 0.17.6 also accepts rule names in preview mode.

options.summary: Disable matching lint rules
options.detail: Use comma-separated codes or prefixes. The more specific selector wins. At equal specificity, ignore takes precedence over select.
